title: Restricted rank gates remain necessary, not Fourier constructions
detail: Bilateral tail, polynomial chart and window gate claims retain their exact hypotheses. The window substitution is valid for natural or invertible-affine Fourier input columns and arbitrary output rows; stored reordered Cooley-Tukey controls explicitly defeat the unrestricted-endpoint substitution. N8 polynomial collapse and N16 screen survival do not give a scalable two-stage evaluator.
actual_stored_witness_impact: No stored witness invalidated. Existing restricted claims are retained without broadening.

title: Full cost ledger and finite-field scope are essential
detail: Prepared weighted-cycle applies and the root-free recurrence path have linear field-operation work; dense Gram diagnostics are cubic, source rotation recomputation is superlinear, and arbitrary input still uses FFT fallback. N oracle basis calls cost O(q*N^2) scalar work for a q-term linear oracle. Fixed F_998244353 supports only dyadic lengths through 2^23; root, inversion, representation and bit costs remain separate.
actual_stored_witness_impact: No new arbitrary-input sub-NlogN or exact-real implementation claim accepted.

title: Phase22 rotation has an existing asymptotic cost gap
detail: phase22_parity.py lines 91-97 call pow independently at every angle and apply_R invokes this preparation each time. This is O(N log N) ordinary field multiplication work; the supplied independent linear_rotation_reference uses consecutive-power recurrence to provide O(N) prepare/apply after setup.
actual_stored_witness_impact: Identity and existing fixed witnesses are unaffected. Historical Phase22 audit already documents this issue and repair; do not present it as a newly discovered theorem.

title: Direct test execution omits later classes
detail: test_phase22.py line 130 invokes unittest.main before four later test methods; test_phase23.py line 108 invokes it before fifteen later methods. Direct execution normally runs only 8/12 and 9/24 respectively. Discovery imports the entire module.
actual_stored_witness_impact: Stored RUN.md and lineage runners use discovery; Phase22 stored log includes all 12 methods. Therefore the direct-mode flaw does not invalidate the recorded discovery route.

title: Public helper validation is weaker than the intended experiment contract
detail: Dimension/length, nonempty-term, true-permutation, nonnegative-trial/rank and primitive-root assumptions are not uniformly enforced. Rotation reference roots are caller-supplied; generic composite n is not certified by its fourth-phase check. Covariance zip loops assume full-length outputs. finite_field_audit uses int64 with no general overflow guard.
actual_stored_witness_impact: All inspected stored callers use supported sizes, fields and shapes; no failing stored witness follows from these hypothetical extensions. Fixed p/n int64 bounds are safe.

title: Reporter success is weaker than the mathematical checks
detail: Some audit reporters write failure statuses or only checksums without asserting final theorem outcomes; run_new omits lower_gate/minor_plane; run_all writes SCREEN_RESULTS before full completion; lineage totals are hardcoded. Stronger assertions live in discovery tests and independent comparison receipts.
actual_stored_witness_impact: Stored data inspected here actually matches its bounded expected outcomes. Presence of a file, exit zero or hardcoded pass text alone is not coverage/execution proof.

title: Finite enumeration and seeded regression are kept separate from all-length proof
detail: N8 permutation enumeration is exhaustive for N8; large screens and matrix cases are finite/seeded. GF2 rank counts do not automatically transfer to F_p. The independent root-free auditor separates integer parity, field checks and binary classification. The necessary filter ceiling 21 remains valid though a separate audit sharpens it to 16.
actual_stored_witness_impact: No finite sample is promoted to universal exclusion or unrestricted algorithmic lower bound.

title: Exact dependencies identified without claiming runtime closure
detail: Candidate exact bundled paths/hashes are recorded for polynomial/rank helpers, the Phase23 resolver, ct_reference_control and independent runner targets. The bilateral loaders mutate sys.path, can reuse sentinel-only trees and have a development fallback. Matching names or inherited theorem acceptance cannot establish actual runtime import binding or whole-source coverage.
actual_stored_witness_impact: Some dependencies have prior full-read evidence; others remain uncovered. Only the 24 assigned hashes earn new credit here; dependency hash reads earn zero.

title: Supplied runners were inertly reviewed, never run
detail: Loaders extract ZIPs and runners launch supplied programs, sometimes at import time. CRC/self-manifest checks do not independently authenticate an archive or ensure complete closed-world dependency coverage. The provenance auditor has meaningful path/size/depth checks but records, rather than externally pins, outer content digests. Hardcoded no-uploaded-execution strings describe intended historical behavior, not a present receipt.
actual_stored_witness_impact: No supplied source execution, import, compile or syntax parse occurred. Source/runners/independent historical programs were all treated as inert supplied bytes.

title: Phase22 controls and Phase23 receipts remain intact
detail: The 24 Phase22 negative statuses and all zero-diagonal counts match the independent receipt; all 12 positives are stored as recovered. Phase23 audit.json equals audit_output.txt as parsed JSON. The Gram-not-Fourier and normalization controls are explicit; correct dimensions and the supported finite field are used.
actual_stored_witness_impact: No newly demonstrated contradiction in these actual stored witnesses. Historical successful results were not freshly rerun.

title: Root-free recurrence extension handles genuine singular branches
detail: For verified order<=2 sequences, the independent implementation evaluates the rational generating-polynomial formula and directly handles at most two exceptional Fourier frequencies. Its recognition is complete for the finite observed-vector recurrence property and avoids data-dependent square roots. Repeated, zero and irreducible roots are included.
actual_stored_witness_impact: This improves a restricted input path only. Stored 36 recurrence/42 adaptive cases remain historical evidence; arbitrary-input worst case stays O(N log N).
